epic.title: Teacher Academics Management Module
epic.body: Enables teachers to manage homework assignments and study materials across their assigned classes, including the ability to target specific students and manage diverse content types like PDFs and external links.

features.title: Homework Lifecycle Management
features.body: Allows teachers to create, update, list, and delete homework assignments with specific due dates, descriptions, and student-level targeting.

stories.title: Homework Management Interface
stories.body: As a teacher, I want to manage homework for my classes, including selecting target students and setting deadlines.
acceptanceCriteria: List: Display homework cards with Subject, Class, Title, Due Date, and Description.
Create: Modal to add title, description, and due date for a selected Class/Subject.
Update: Ability to edit existing homework details using the same form.
Delete: Remove an assignment with a confirmation prompt.
Targeting: Toggle between 'Assign to All' and 'Select Students' to assign work to specific individuals in a class.
Validation: Ensure homework is flagged as 'isOwner' only for the teacher who created it.

stories.title: Homework Persistence & Targeting API
stories.body: Backend API to store homework data and manage the relationship between assignments and targeted students.
acceptanceCriteria: POST/PUT: Save and update homework metadata and student-assignment mappings.
GET: Retrieve homework filtered by class and teacher ownership.
DELETE: Endpoint to remove homework and associated student submission records.
Calculations: Serve 'pendingHomework' counts per class for the teacher dashboard.

features.title: Study Material Repository
features.body: Management of educational resources including PDFs, PPTs, and external web links for student reference.

stories.title: Study Material Management UI
stories.body: As a teacher, I want to upload and categorize study materials like notes and guides for my students.
acceptanceCriteria: List: Display materials categorized by type (PDF, PPT, Link) with metadata like file size and upload date.
Create: Form to add title and resource type; supports file upload for PDF/PPT or URL entry for Links.
Update/Delete: Full CRUD support for teacher-owned materials.
Subject Color-Coding: Automatically apply distinct colors to material cards based on the subject (e.g., Blue for Math, Green for Science).

stories.title: Resource Management API
stories.body: API for handling file metadata, external links, and resource organization by class and subject.
acceptanceCriteria: POST/PUT: Endpoints to save material title, type, and associated file reference or link.
GET: Retrieve materials filtered by class and subject with owner-verification.
DELETE: Remove resource records and trigger cleanup of stored files.
